arguments.value: Aduro Biotech, Inc. and IREYA B.V. entered into a consulting agreement effective July 1, 2020. IREYA B.V., represented by Andrea van Elsas, will provide advice and consultation to Aduro on research, clinical development programs, and other business matters as Aduro requests. Aduro will pay €500 per hour, and IREYA B.V. may be reimbursed for pre-approved travel and out-of-pocket expenses with proper invoices and documentation; expenses over €5,000 individually or €20,000 in the aggregate require prior written consent. The agreement runs until December 31, 2020 unless extended or ended earlier by either party on prior written notice. IREYA B.V. must keep Aduro’s confidential information secret, use it only to perform the services, and return or destroy it when requested or when the agreement ends, subject to whistleblower protections. Any work product created in performing the services belongs to Aduro, and IREYA B.V. must assign related rights to Aduro and assist as needed. IREYA B.V. also agrees not to solicit Aduro employees or contractors during the agreement and for 12 months after it ends, to act as an independent contractor, to avoid conflicts of interest, and to comply with insider trading rules. The agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California.
